The most recent observation (CURRENT) reveals dramatic changes: both the Money Plant and the Mexican Mint are no longer visible. The Money Plant appears to have been physically removed, while the Mexican Mint has either been removed or has completely degraded/died within its pot. The white tube remains on the desk. This sequence indicates a significant decline and loss of the monitored botanical specimens.
